limits_note: `retention-clamped` + restore path: objects are listed but not downloadable until restored; restore target is Standard Multi-AZ only (lifecycle rules are top-down, so you cannot restore Glacier -> One Zone); restore start takes minutes to 24 h for objects over 1 MB; default restore window is 1 day and the object is billed at Standard Multi-AZ while restored.
